fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company name from the original posting.

fields.label: Job title
fields.description: Use the original job title, without adding a seniority level.

fields.label: Eligible location
fields.description: Where applicants may work from; remote does not mean worldwide.

fields.label: Responsibilities
fields.description: Summarize the work in English; do not copy the full posting.

fields.label: Requirements
fields.description: Summarize required and preferred qualifications separately.

fields.label: Compensation
fields.description: Include currency and pay period when stated; otherwise say not disclosed.

fields.label: Application and working conditions
fields.description: Include language, schedule, benefits and visa information only when confirmed; mark unknowns explicitly.

fields.label: Original posting and application
fields.description: Use a public HTTPS link; remove tracking parameters, preserve the job identifier.

fields.label: Source key
fields.description: Stable provider:board:job-id, or company:job-id. Search all issues for this key before posting.

fields.label: Published on
fields.description: Original publication date (YYYY-MM-DD), verified at the employer source. An update, crawl or discovery date is not a publication date.

fields.label: Last checked
fields.description: Date you verified the original posting, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

groups.label: Role
groups.description: Select only explicitly supported values; use unspecified when unknown.

values.it: IT support, operations and governance roles
values.operations: Business operations and process improvement roles

groups.label: Specialty
groups.description: Select only explicitly supported values; use unspecified when unknown.

values.game-development: Game programming, technical art and production
values.visual-design: Visual design, animation and digital art

groups.label: Seniority
groups.description: Select only explicitly supported values; use unspecified when unknown.

values.unspecified: Level not explicitly stated; do not infer Staff from Architect
values.lead: Explicit technical lead roles; not necessarily people management
values.entry-level: Graduate, trainee, working-student or explicitly early-career roles; check experience requirements

groups.label: Work arrangement
groups.description: Select only explicitly supported values; use unspecified when unknown.

values.remote: Remote work; check the separate eligible region

groups.label: Employment type
groups.description: Select only explicitly supported values; use unspecified when unknown.

values.permanent: Permanent employee position; working hours are stated separately
values.apprenticeship: Explicit apprenticeship or alternating work-study contract

groups.label: Eligible region
groups.description: Select only explicitly supported values; use unspecified when unknown.

values.latam: Applicants may work from Latin America
values.us: Applicants may work from the United States
values.uae: Work based in the United Arab Emirates; check relocation conditions
values.costa-rica: Applicants may work from Costa Rica
